# F6: Fit and finish, map-reviews

A check of the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/6-map-reviews.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, map-reviews (per-area reports, 4 Nov).
